capabilities.expDetail: wgpu WebGPU (4-worker single-threaded pool and SharedArrayBuffer multithreaded pool with on-arrival event waking)
capabilities.mlnDetail: OffscreenCanvas + dedicated Map Worker + MessageChannel Tile Workers, zero COOP/COEP requirement, built-in WebGL2 fallback

capabilities.expDetail: Full MapController::setStyle (URL / JSON / object + TileJSON resolution) diffing sources & preserving cached tiles
capabilities.mlnDetail: Native WebMap::set_style_url with preloaded resource reuse

capabilities.dimension: 3D DEM Elevation Terrain Mesh & Vector Draping (style.terrain)
capabilities.expDetail: Full raster-dem (terrarium/mapbox), 3D elevation mesh displacement, DrapeCache vector draping & subterranean camera clamping
capabilities.mlnDetail: 2D hillshade & color-relief only; mln_style explicitly reports "the map doesn't draw terrain"

capabilities.expDetail: Supports fill-extrusion, globe & vertical-perspective projections with 6DoF roll/pitch camera
capabilities.mlnDetail: Supports fill-extrusion, projection: globe & set_globe_free_bearing trans-polar navigation

capabilities.dimension: Native XR Stereo Rendering (visionOS / HMD Stereo) & WebXR
capabilities.expDetail: HeadlessMap::run_xr_frame supports asymmetric per-eye frusta + CoveringPolicy::StereoReuse dual-eye tile sharing + apple/visionos target
capabilities.mlnDetail: No native multi-view stereo XR pipeline or visionOS / WebXR target
capabilities.gljsReference: No official dual-eye stereo tile-sharing pipeline

capabilities.dimension: Desktop & Mobile Native Host + Offline SQLite Cache
capabilities.expDetail: Supports macOS/Linux/Windows/Android/iOS/visionOS hosts + rusqlite OfflineDatabase region pack manager & MBTiles/PMTiles
capabilities.mlnDetail: Direct MapLibre Native C++ lineage with rusqlite offline storage, HTTP conditional cache & C ABI/FFI

capabilities.dimension: Complex Script Shaping (RTL / Indic / HarfRust) & Local CJK Glyphs
capabilities.expDetail: Native HarfRust + skrifa GSUB/GPOS shaping (optional font-shaping feature) + zero-download browser OffscreenCanvas 2D CJK SDF
capabilities.mlnDetail: On-demand mln_web_shaper (HarfRust + skrifa + FreeType) plus zero-download localIdeographFontFamily CJK rendering
